articles.summary: Lagos, Nigeria, December 6, 2023 – Tizeti, West Africa’s pioneering solar-based internet service provider, proudly announces strategic leadership appointments as part of its ongoing expansion efforts. Lydia Asogwa Anyimson assumes the role of Country Manager for West Africa, while Ehimen Iziengbe joins as Vice President, Engineering. articles.title: Tizeti expands Leadership team ahead of major West African Expansion
